expr: (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]')].map(x=>x.value), s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'); const S=window.simState; return r.join()==='0,2,0' && s.value==='1' && S.s0===0 && S.v===2 && S.t===0 && S.s===0 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const o=[...document.querySelector('#sim-root select').options].map(x=>x.textContent+':'+x.value).join(','); return o==='hidas:0.5,normaali:1,nopea:2' && document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select').length===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one select, speed: hidas 0.5, normaali 1, nopea 2

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Käynnistä first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const L=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label'); const t=[...L].map(x=>simText(x)); return L.length===4 && /^Alkupaikka \$s_0 = 0\\,\\text\{m\}\$/.test(t[0]) && /^Nopeus \$v = 2\{,\}0\\,\\text\{m\/s\}\$/.test(t[1]) && /^Hetki \$t = 0\{,\}0\\,\\text\{s\}\$/.test(t[2]) && t[3].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four labelled controls with units: Alkupaikka s_0 (m), Nopeus v (m/s), Hetki t (s), Nopeus (toisto)

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words (explanations live in the lesson's inquiry.json)

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='s0,t,v' && P.s0.unit==='m' && P.v.unit==='m/s' && P.t.unit==='s' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares s0 (m), v (m/s) and t (s)
